title: Claims Desk Figures: Special Theft Limits, Holdback and Recovery Periods under HomeGuard
content:
Special limits and settlement figures by package, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy. The claims desk reads these figures from the column of the package on the declarations.

## Reference card

| Figure | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Theft of jewelry, watches and furs — special limit under Coverage C (USD) | 1500 | 1500 | 2500 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 |
| Theft of firearms — special limit under Coverage C (USD) | 2500 | 2500 | 5000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 |
| Money, bank notes and coins — special limit under Coverage C (USD) | 200 | 200 | 500 | 200 | 500 | 1000 |
| No-holdback threshold: replacement-cost loss amount per coverage part at or below which full replacement cost is paid without withholding depreciation (USD) | 0 (always withheld) | 1000 | 2500 | 1000 | 2500 | 10000 |
| Depreciation recovery period after the initial actual-cash-value payment (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 730 |
| Wind or hail reporting period after the date of loss (calendar days) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Mortgagee co-payee threshold for a dwelling or other-structures payment (USD) | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 |

Column headings shorten HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.

## Meaning of each figure

- **Special theft limits.** Under Coverage C, theft of jewelry, watches and furs, theft of firearms, and loss of money, bank notes and coins are each limited to the package's special limit.
- **No-holdback threshold.** Compared with the replacement-cost loss amount of one coverage part. At or below the threshold, the full replacement cost is paid without withholding depreciation; a threshold of 0 means depreciation is always withheld.
- **Depreciation recovery period.** The number of calendar days after the initial actual-cash-value payment within which repair or replacement must be completed and documented to recover withheld depreciation.
- **Wind or hail reporting period.** The number of calendar days after the date of loss within which a wind or hail claim must be reported.
- **Mortgagee co-payee threshold.** A dwelling or other-structures payment at or above this amount names the mortgagee as co-payee.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical amounts)

| Hypothetical input | Package | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Replacement-cost loss on one coverage part of 1000.00 | HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | at the threshold of 1000: full replacement cost, nothing withheld |
| Replacement-cost loss on one coverage part of 1000.01 | HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | above the threshold: depreciation is withheld |
| Replacement-cost loss on one coverage part of 400.00 | HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | threshold 0: depreciation is withheld |
| Dwelling payment of 2500.00 | any package | at the co-payee threshold: the mortgagee is named as co-payee |
| Dwelling payment of 2499.99 | any package | below the co-payee threshold |
| Stolen jewelry valued at 4000.00 | HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | limited to 2500 |
